heading.en: A million times more than burning

hook.en: Burning one kilogram of coal gives about 30 million joules. Splitting one kilogram of uranium-235 gives about eighty million million joules. Both come from binding *energy*.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ಕೆ.ಜಿ ಕಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಲು ಸುಟ್ಟರೆ ಸುಮಾರು 3 × 10⁷ J. ಒಂದು ಕೆ.ಜಿ ಯುರೇನಿಯಂ-235 ವಿದಳನದಿಂದ ಸುಮಾರು 8 × 10¹³ J. ಎರಡೂ ಬಂಧನ ಶಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ.

say.en: Burning one kilogram of coal gives about 30 million joules. Splitting one kilogram of uranium-235 gives about eighty million million joules. Both come from binding energy. In this lesson: Explain fission and fusion using the BE over A curve.

body.en: When a slow neutron is absorbed by ²³⁵U, the nucleus splits into two medium nuclei, such as ¹⁴⁴Ba and ⁸⁹Kr, and releases two or three neutrons: $^{235}_{92}\text{U} + n \to {}^{144}_{56}\text{Ba} + {}^{89}_{36}\text{Kr} + 3n$. The fragments have a higher binding energy per nucleon (about 8.5 MeV) than uranium (about 7.6 MeV), so about 200 MeV is released per *fission*.
body.kn: ಮಂದ ನ್ಯೂಟ್ರಾನ್ ಹೀರಿದ ²³⁵U ಎರಡು ಮಧ್ಯಮ ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಸ್‌ಗಳಾಗಿ ಒಡೆದು 2–3 ನ್ಯೂಟ್ರಾನ್ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ವಿದಳನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು 200 MeV ಶಕ್ತಿ.

narration.en: Let us draw a fission event, a chain reaction and the fusion that powers the Sun.

say.en: A slow neutron is absorbed by uranium-235, which splits into two middle-sized nuclei and releases two or three neutrons.
Why so much energy? B/A rises from about 7.6 MeV to about 8.5 MeV, and 235 nucleons each gain about 0.9 MeV.
Each fission frees more neutrons, which cause more fissions. If on average more than one goes on to cause fission, the chain grows; exactly one keeps it steady, as in a reactor.
In fusion, light nuclei join. In the Sun four protons end up as one helium-4, releasing 26.7 MeV; this needs temperatures of about ten million kelvin.
One gram of uranium-235 holds 2.56 × 10²¹ nuclei. At 200 MeV each, full fission gives about 8 × 10¹⁰ joule.
Let us draw a fission event, a chain reaction and the fusion that powers the Sun.

narration.en: Each U-235 fission releases about 200 MeV and 2 to 3 neutrons. If on average k of them cause another fission, the number grows as k per generation. k > 1: the reaction runs away (a bomb). k = 1: steady (a reactor, held there by control rods). k < 1: it dies out.

caption.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ U-235 ವಿದಳನ ಸುಮಾರು 200 MeV ಮತ್ತು 2–3 ನ್ಯೂಟ್ರಾನ್ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರಾಸರಿ k ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ವಿದಳನ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಪೀಳಿಗೆಗೆ k ಪಟ್ಟು. k > 1: ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ತಪ್ಪುತ್ತದೆ (ಬಾಂಬ್). k = 1: ಸ್ಥಿರ (ರಿಯಾಕ್ಟರ್, ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಸರಳುಗಳಿಂದ). k < 1: ನಿಂತುಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: When two light nuclei join to form a heavier one, the binding energy per nucleon increases and energy is released. The nuclei must get close enough for the *nuclear* force to act, against their Coulomb repulsion, so fusion needs temperatures of about $10^7$ K: thermonuclear fusion. In the Sun's core, four protons are fused into a helium nucleus, releasing 26.7 MeV.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Estimate the energy released by the complete fission of 1 kilogram of to the power 235U, at 200 mega electron volts per fission.
Number of nuclei N equals (1000 over 235) times 6.02 times 10 to the power 23 is approximately 2.56 times 10 to the power 24.
Energy per fission equals 200 times 1.6 times 10 to the power minus 13 joules equals 3.2 times 10 to the power minus 11 joules.
Total is approximately 2.56 times 10 to the power 24 times 3.2 times 10 to the power minus 11 is approximately 8.2 times 10 to the power 13 joules.
So the answer is is approximately 8.2 times 10 to the power 13 joules.
